punchline: A famous scientist said "moonshine"; Szilard heard a condition to test.
thirty_sec: In September 1933 Leo Szilard, waiting at traffic lights on Southampton Row, saw that an element splitting under neutrons and releasing more neutrons could sustain a chain reaction; he patented the idea in 1934, assigning it to the British Admiralty.
question: Which "that can't work" are you carrying, and what one condition would change it?
key_contrast: A verdict closes the question; a condition shows where to look.
